simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גּוּד (H1464) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גּוּד (gûwd) means to crowd upon , i.e. attack First listed occurrence: Gen 49 19.

definitions.full: H1464. gud [ גּוּד ] verb invade, attack (compare גדד , whence יָגֻד etc. actually derived by Ki Bö Kö i. 356 q. v.; SS, perhaps better, denominative from גדוד ) — Qal Imperfect יָגֻד Gen 49:19 , יְגוּדֶ֑נּוּ 49:19 , יְגֻדֶנּ֑וּ Hab 3:16 ; יגודו Psa 94:21 Kt (see גדד ); — attack Gen 49:19 , alliteration with גָּד proper name & ׃ עֵָקב יָגֻד וְהוּא יְגוּדֶנּ֑וּ גְּדוּד גָּד גְּדוּד, Gad, a troop shall troop upon him, but he shall troop upon the heel (i.e. pursue them in their retreat) VB; Hab 3:16 יְגֻדֶ֑נּוּ לְעַם לַעֲלוֺת compare VB & Comm.
